result:
- **Cause:** Test-order leak through the static `PriceCache`. `PromotionTests.Promotion_ReducesPrice_WhileActive` puts MUG on 20% off (10.00) and never ends the promotion. `CatalogTests` and `PromotionTests` were the only catalog tests not deriving from `StorefrontTestBase`, which clears the cache before each test. So when the promotion test ran first, `Catalog_ReturnsListPrice_ForKnownSku` read the stale 10.00. The `TryPriceOf` change in this MR is not at fault.
- **Action:** Test-only change in `tests/Storefront.Specs/CatalogTests.cs` and `tests/Storefront.Specs/PromotionTests.cs`: both now inherit `StorefrontTestBase` and use its `Catalog` instead of their own `_catalog` field. No production code changed.

The 11 catalog, promotion and price-cache tests pass locally; I did not run the full suite. Nothing is committed or pushed, so the pipeline won't go green until you push it.
